source.title: dion
source.baseline: Mercenary III research baseline (pinned ST STX)

machine.stack: $56D6 (long pointer; stack of longs grows down from $56D6)
machine.branchRule: taken when condition XOR bit 7; bit 6 = call instead of jump; target word relative to $6FD44

opcodes.name: end
opcodes.meaning: PC = $6FF54 (idle loop), clear flag 6, empty the stack

opcodes.name: ascii_text
opcodes.meaning: message from inline zero-terminated ASCII (not centred); hold = word $6FF46; request bar

opcodes.name: if_random_below
opcodes.meaning: condition: low byte of the next random word < operand; the word at ($75A6) is rotated right one bit and $75A6 advances within $DC00..$DFFE

opcodes.name: if_key
opcodes.meaning: condition: byte $71FB == operand; a match also clicks ($55B6A)

opcodes.name: if_object_held
opcodes.meaning: condition: bit 7 of object state byte $641E+4*o

opcodes.name: add_account
opcodes.meaning: account $6B1E+8*n += six BCD bytes (n = $F8 is cash $72DE, and also clicks)

opcodes.name: set_flag
opcodes.meaning: set flag n; for n < 6 also write $B47A to $7556+4n and $B33A to $7582+4n, and start script $10 once flags 0-5 are all set

opcodes.name: id_message
opcodes.meaning: message n from the ID table without its header (n >= $F0: message number from word $70DE+2n); hold = word $6FF46; request bar

opcodes.name: add_accounts
opcodes.meaning: account a = account b + account c (BCD; a = $F8 clicks)

opcodes.name: adjust_6EAA
opcodes.meaning: $6EAA = BCD($6EAA + operand), at most $99 (no bit 7) or at least $01 (bit 7); $6EAB = BCD(100 - $6EAA)

opcodes.name: store2
opcodes.meaning: two bytes to $6FD44 + offset (script bank: $0202 hold $6FF46, $0206 cabin animation $6FF4A)

opcodes.name: random_message
opcodes.meaning: message ((next random word & mask) + base) without its header; hold = word $6FF46

opcodes.name: halt
opcodes.meaning: returns without advancing PC, so it repeats every frame

opcodes.name: self_copy
opcodes.meaning: copies word $70DE+2n onto itself, n = the next byte, which is not consumed (no effect)

opcodes.name: if_72D8_is_71F4
opcodes.meaning: condition: low byte of word $72D8 == byte $71F4

opcodes.name: object_bit
opcodes.meaning: operand b negative: set bit (b & 7) of $641E+4*o; otherwise clear it

opcodes.name: if_7125
opcodes.meaning: condition: operand == word at odd address $7125 (a 68000 address error if reached)

opcodes.name: packed_text
opcodes.meaning: decode packed text ($52AC4), centred; hold = word $6FF46; request bar

opcodes.name: model_swap_a
opcodes.meaning: model table [$4BD10]: +$C2 = +$278, +$1B4 = +$27A; clear bit 4 of $679E and $65A2; $6E84 = $FFFF

opcodes.name: if_taxi_passenger
opcodes.meaning: condition: bit 6 of $6EB3 set and word $6CBC negative
